items.text: Copper fell 7.5%, Gold fell 5.2% and Hang Seng fell 5.2% over the past week, big moves for each. Usually a drag on Integrated Steel, Aluminium & Extrusions and Copper.
The NIFTY 500 rose 0.8% on 20 Nov. Diversified was the strongest sector (−0.0%) and Forest Materials the weakest (−1.2%).

FIIs bought a net ₹7,411 Cr and DIIs sold a net ₹1,357 Cr of Indian shares on 19 Nov. Foreign investors are quietly accumulating in 65 niches; Pipes & Tubes, Gas Transmission & LNG and US Generics joined today. Heavy delivery buying this week in Large PSU Banks, Luggage & Bags and Small PSU Banks.
